text:
alejandra: Quick sync thread: we're evaluating a pattern to avoid requiring PrivateLink for every tenant control-plane read. Two patterns: (A) require PrivateLink always, (B) allow in-VPC read-only cache agent with outbound invalidation tunnel. Thoughts?

max: Pattern B reduces cross-region latency and egress for high-traffic tenants. Pattern A is simpler for ops and compliance.

ryan: If we go with B, we need a robust invalidation and "kill-switch" mechanism. Also need to categorize operations by sensitivity: cert revocation and attestation must be treated stricter.

alejandra: Sensitivity matrix proposal: CERT_REVOKE (HIGH), TOKEN_ISSUE (HIGH), METADATA_READ (LOW). High means fail-closed unless authoritative CP can be reached.

max: Architecturally, I like outbound-only gRPC stream to a CP relay. Advantages: firewall friendly, easy to scale, TLS mTLS, sequence numbers on messages.

ryan: We'll need bootstrap: agent uses PrivateLink once to fetch initial state and a short-lived bootstrap token. After that, persistent outbound gRPC. This limits PrivateLink footprint.

sre-bot: created ticket RED-NTW-601 for prototype + added owners @alejandra @max.

alejandra: Audit trail options: (1) agent forwards each decision to CP in realtime; (2) agent emits signed digests every N seconds; (3) agent only forwards high-sensitivity ops realtime. Recommend (3) by default.

sec-team: Security note: BYOK for signing assertions must be supported for regulated customers. Also require HSM integration where requested.

max: Fallback flow sketch:
```
if sensitivity==HIGH:
  if cache.valid: return
  elif outbound_stream.ok: fetch authoritative; if ok: return
  else: return 403
else:
  try cache, else try outbound, else privatelink if available, else warn+return stale
```

ryan: Rollout: implement 2-phase pilot: internal-only tenant + 2 external tenants. collect metrics: invalidation_latency_ms, ttfb_ms, cache_hit_rate, egress_bytes.

alejandra: Ops: helm chart, auto-update sidecar for minor versions, explicit opt-in via tenant flag. Major upgrades will require support signoff.

max: sync diagram idea: include sequence numbers, tombstone topic, and per-tenant topic ACLs. Also add agent health heartbeats with last_applied_seq.

alejandra: Decision (tentative): opt-in read cache agent with persistent outbound-only gRPC stream for invalidations. PrivateLink remains default; local cache allowed for customers that meet operational pre-reqs (bootstrap via PrivateLink, enable invalidation channel, audit flags). We'll draft RFC follow-up with exact message format.

sec-team: +1 but require BYOK workstream planning.

alejandra: Thanks all. I'll post an RFC with the sensitivity matrix and fallback pseudocode. Keep adding comments here.
